title: FP8 activation safety net: hysteresis-based rollout, gradient-aware telemetry, and lightweight shadow calibration
creator: Amira Patel
description: Goal: enable FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) for select Hopper-backed models with a conservative, observable activation path that minimizes accuracy regressions and avoids user-visible failures. This ticket implements a multi-layer safety net: 1) hysteresis-based activation thresholds so a model flips to FP8 only after sustained stability, 2) gradient-aware telemetry signals to detect subtle distributional accuracy drift, and 3) a lightweight shadow calibration run that samples live traffic for end-to-end validation without serving model outputs.
acceptance_criteria: Production canary runs automatically enable FP8 for a target model only after 48 hours of stable key metrics (token error rate, perplexity delta, and latency within SLO)
Telemetry pipeline exposes gradient-aware alerts (drift score and sample-level regression flag) and integrates with rollout gating for automatic rollback
Shadow calibration jobs produce per-model calibration snapshots and a delta report that is consumed by the decision service
End-to-end CI includes a synthetic regression test suite ensuring <0.7% token-level degradation vs baseline on held-out prompt sets before release
Documentation and runbook for on-call describing triggers, mitigation steps, and safe rollback procedures
comments: 2026-03-01 Amira Patel: Kickoff meeting notes: agreed to avoid global immediate activation. We'll gate FP8 activation behind a combination of stability windows and telemetry signals. Jonah to prototype hysteresis controller and shadow calibration harness.

2026-03-03 Jonah Kim: Prototype hysteresis controller checked in on branch feat/hysteresis-fp8. Controller looks for consecutive stable windows (configurable: window=6h, required=8 windows) before enabling profile. Added unit tests for windowing logic.

2026-03-05 QA: Early canary on small internal model (eng-chat-small) produced intermittent perplexity spikes when under bursty traffic. Root cause traced to KV cache eviction timing interacting with the FP8 runtime's per-layer scale factors. Added mitigation: align prefix cache flush with activation boundary.

2026-03-07 Jonah Kim: Implemented gradient-aware telemetry probe. Computes a lightweight distributional score by sampling last-layer logits on a small request slice. Score bumped into observability pipeline as custom metric: fp8_drift_score.

2026-03-08 Observability: Added a debug-only span to payload path for shadow calibration samples. Shadow runs sample 1:50 of live traffic and calls a calibration-only path that does quantization traces without returning outputs to clients.

2026-03-09 Performance: Found a 5-7% latency tail increase on N=2048 contexts when shadow calibration enabled. Reduced sampling from 2% to 0.5% and moved shadow jobs to a lower-priority queue; tail improved back to baseline.

2026-03-10 Jonah Kim: Implemented automatic rollback hooks. Rollback triggers: fp8_drift_score > 0.12 for 3 consecutive 15m buckets OR token_error_rate regression > 0.8% sustained for 30 minutes. Hooks create a rollback task and auto-notify on-call.

2026-03-11 Experimental results: On medium-sized transformer (model-tb-1B), FP8 E4M3 gives 2.1x throughput improvement with measured token-level BLEU regression of 0.35% on our eval set. E5M2 shows slightly better numerical stability for attention layers in long-context capture tests.

2026-03-12 Release planning: Draft rollout plan reviewed with SRE and Product. Security reviewed shadow calibration mechanism for PII leakage and confirmed sampling and retention policies comply with data-handling guidelines.

2026-03-12 Amira Patel: Next actions: finalize hysteresis thresholds in config, wire drift_score to rollout controller, extend CI regression suite with two new prompt sets targeting long-context safety, schedule a 3-day internal canary starting 2026-03-18.
telemetry_checks: fp8_drift_score: bucketed 15m; alert threshold 0.12; sustained window 3 buckets triggers rollback gating
token_error_rate: compare against baseline model-rolling-avg; relative delta > 0.8% sustained 30m creates critical alert
latency_p99: must remain within 1.15x of baseline or pause activation until improved
kv_cache_miss_rate: monitor for >2x spike during activation windows
shadow_calibration_mismatch_rate: fraction of sampled requests where calibrated quant params diverge from offline baseline >1% flags review
test_results_summary: Unit tests: hysteresis controller edge cases, window wrap-around, and configuration parsing — all passing
Integration: shadow calibration flow validated on staging; sampling and trace capture verified end-to-end
Performance: E4M3 on Hopper (A100-like staging cluster) shows 1.9-2.2x token throughput vs INT8 baseline at batch sizes 8-32
Accuracy: internal eval suites show median token-regression 0.3% for E4M3, 0.2% for E5M2 on conversational prompts; long-context prompt set shows elevated regressions for some attention patterns
Canary safety: synthetic stress runs induced a fail-case where KV cache flush timing produced attention noise — mitigation implemented and re-tested
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Staging validation (done): shadow calibration on staging with 0.5% sampling for 72h
Phase 1 - Internal canary (2026-03-18 to 2026-03-21): deploy FP8 E4M3 to 2 internal services with hysteresis window=6h required=8; monitor telemetry in real-time; have rollback preapproved
Phase 2 - Partner canary (2 customers): increase sampling to 1% and enable E5M2 for models tagged long-context; collect feedback and adjust quantization scales
Phase 3 - Gradual ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 50% traffic buckets with 48h hold per step and automatic gating based on telemetry
Phase 4 - General availability: enable opt-in on Redwood API with explicit model profiles; provide opt-out knob and runtime fallback to INT8
